name: The Scottish Highlands
tagline: Glens, sea lochs and single-track roads that ask you to slow down.
distinctive: The western Highlands combine mountains, sea lochs and white-sand beaches, with a light that changes by the minute. The roads are part of the experience and reward patience.

image.alt: A car on the empty road through Glen Coe beneath Buachaille Etive Mòr

moodNotes.drive: Glencoe, the Road to the Isles and the single-track roads of the west are legendary.
moodNotes.wellness: Long walks, big skies, sea swimming for the brave and a fire in the evening.
moodNotes.lifetime: A clear evening on the western coast, looking toward the islands, stays with you.
moodNotes.sea: Sea lochs and the white beaches of Arisaig and Morar.

seasonNote: Late spring to early autumn has the longest days. Midges can be troublesome on still summer evenings in the west.

arrival.transfer: Fort William is roughly two hours by road from Inverness, and a little more from Glasgow.
arrival.groundNote: Collect the car at the airport. Distances look short on the map, but the roads are slow.

driving.note: Many roads are single-track with passing places. Drive unhurriedly, pull in to let others pass, and allow more time than the map suggests.

carWhy: Height, visibility and composure on narrow, wet roads matter more here than outright pace.

transfer.label: West Highland Line
transfer.why: The train from Glasgow to Fort William and Mallaig is itself one of Britain's great journeys.

stay.name: Inverlochy Castle Hotel
stay.why: A Victorian castle hotel in its own grounds beneath Ben Nevis, central for Glencoe and the Road to the Isles.

watchWhy: Robust, legible and water-resistant, a watch to wear in weather that changes by the hour.
aromaWhy: Heather, bog myrtle and a wisp of peat smoke: the Highlands after rain, brought indoors.

days.title: The Great Glen
days.text: Drive from Inverness along Loch Ness to Fort William, stopping wherever the light is good.

days.title: Glencoe
days.text: Take a morning drive and a walk in Glencoe, then visit Glenfinnan's viaduct and monument in the afternoon.

days.title: The Road to the Isles
days.text: Follow the road west to the white beaches of Arisaig and Morar. Have lunch by the sea and watch the sunset over the islands.

moreDays.title: Skye
moreDays.text: Cross to Skye for the Quiraing and the Trotternish coast.

moreDays.title: A distillery
moreDays.text: Tour a Highland distillery. Choose a nominated driver, or have one of ours.

moreDays.title: Applecross
moreDays.text: Take the Bealach na Bà, a steep single-track pass for confident drivers only, in good weather.
